title: valance.json
description: The project: what the application is called. Settings for a target are in valance.<target>.json (valance.web.json for the web).

version.description: The version of this file's format.

name.description: The application's name: the site's title in navigation and in every page's <title>.

title.description: How a document's title is written: "{page}" is the page's title and "{site}" the name above. Must contain "{page}". A page whose title is the site's name is that name alone.

record.description: What `vlx dev --record` leaves out of a session log. A log holds what was typed and seen; a value marked here is never written (its place holds a digest) and the log still replays.

scope.description: Paths into the page's scope whose values are replaced by a digest; "*" is any list index or field name.

commands.description: Commands ("component/name") whose parameters are not recorded.

budgets.description: The size budgets `vlx build` holds the production build to (never `vlx dev`). A type, a warning and an error threshold in bytes: 500000, "500kB" or "1MB" (1 kB is 1,000 bytes). With none, the framework's start-up budgets apply.

type.description: initial: the start-up JavaScript and CSS; runtime: the WebAssembly runtime; startup: the whole start-up set; afterStart: what loads once the application runs; anyChunk: the largest JavaScript chunk. Brotli bytes.
